architecture.decoder: combine tracked determinant with the ninth power of each measured trace; fuse with the existing W33 projective packet
architecture.determinant: tracked from the programmed Clifford word and calibrated phase plates
architecture.register: nine-mode two-qutrit register randomized uniformly over computational modes
architecture.shot_1: controlled-path U, X/Y path readout estimates Tr(U)/9
architecture.shot_2: controlled-path U^2, X/Y path readout estimates Tr(U^2)/9

boundary: The shot count is a worst-case Hoeffding design point assuming independent binary path measurements, exact determinant tracking, and no drift. Loss, phase diffusion, visibility, and detector imbalance must be calibrated experimentally; black-box modular DQC1 without a phase reference gives only trace modulus and is insufficient for the full class sensor.
